caption: The drawing depicts three main objects placed on a rectangular metal base with a blackish-blue finish. On the left side is a red barrel with horizontal bands and a small hole on the side. In the center stands a figure of a human character with a pointed hat, wearing a suit with gold-colored buttons and a white ruffled collar and cuffs; the figure holds a whip in one hand and has its other hand resting on its hip, with a confident stance. To the right of the character is a small dog with a curly tail, colored mostly in shades of brown and gray, facing the figure and with its mouth open. Several small coins or round objects are scattered on the platform between the figure and the dog. The objects are all rendered in a realistic style with careful attention paid to textures and metallic surfaces. The background is plain and uncolored, and the artist's name, Eduard Buescher, is printed in small text on the lower right side of the image.
title: Mechanical Bank: Jumping Dog
